headline: Nigerian Naira Weakens in October Amid Liquidity Cushions
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated against the dollar across foreign exchange market segments in October, despite rising external reserves and increased liquidity.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations in emerging markets impact import costs, foreign investor returns, and local monetary policy decisions.

impacts.name: Nigerian naira
impacts.why: The report directly tracks the depreciation of the naira against the US dollar.
